id.description: The unique ID of the webhook endpoint.

object.description: The object type, which is always webhook_endpoint.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp when the endpoint was created.

updated_at.description: The Unix timestamp of the last endpoint configuration or signing-secret change. Initialized at creation; tests and unchanged updates do not advance it.

name.description: The human-readable name of the endpoint.

url.description: The HTTPS URL that receives webhook deliveries.

event_types.description: The event types that trigger deliveries to this endpoint.

anyOf.description: A masked hint for the endpoint's signing secret.

signing_secret.description: The endpoint's signing secret. This is returned only when the endpoint is created or the secret is rotated.
